definitions.explanation: A train that stops at every station along its route. The slowest but cheapest type of train service, requiring no special ticket or surcharge.

examples.japanese: {普通|ふつう}{列車|れっしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{普通|ふつう}{列車|れっしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何時|なんじ}→何時：00973_nanji⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: What time is the next local train?

examples.japanese: {普通|ふつう}{列車|れっしゃ}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{二時間|にじかん}→二時間：27637_nijikan⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{特急|とっきゅう}→特急：01476_tokkyuu⟧なら⟦{一時間|いちじかん}→一時間：00941_ichijikan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{着|つ}く→着く：00680_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: The local train takes two hours, but the express gets there in one.

notes:
The most basic train service class in Japan, stopping at every station. Often shortened to ⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧ in conversation and on station signs.

JAPAN TRAIN HIERARCHY (slowest to fastest):
- ⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧/⟦{各駅停車|かくえきていしゃ}→各駅停車：15471_kakuekiteisha⟧: local (stops at all stations)
- ⟦{快速|かいそく}→快速：09213_kaisoku⟧: rapid
- ⟦{急行|きゅうこう}→急行：01386_kyuukou⟧: express
- ⟦{特急|とっきゅう}→特急：01476_tokkyuu⟧: limited express
- ⟦{新幹線|しんかんせん}→新幹線：01053_shinkansen⟧: bullet train

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {普通|ふつう}{列車|れっしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{切符|きっぷ}→切符：00643_kippu⟧: local train ticket
- {普通|ふつう}{列車|れっしゃ}⟦{自由席|じゆうせき}→自由席：07047_jiyuuseki⟧: unreserved seat on a local train

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{各駅停車|かくえきていしゃ}→各駅停車：15471_kakuekiteisha⟧: local train (lit. stopping at each station) — synonym, more descriptive
- {鈍行|どんこう}: slow train — colloquial, slightly old-fashioned

USAGE:
No additional fare is required beyond the basic ticket price. On station platforms, displayed as ⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧ on departure boards.
